text:
Sam: Morning all — quick CEO weekly note. Short version: Private GA remains on track for end-of-month; EU region rollout next week; focus this sprint is stability + predictable economics. High-level asks below and a couple of risks to watch.

Sam: Metrics snapshot — prod QPS +12% week-over-week, median generation latency ~110ms, p99 ~450ms (after batching defaults). Unit cost down ~6% due to Optimize suggestions and smarter batching. Customer pilot engagement up 3 net new pilots.

Sam: Three operational asks: 1) Pilot velocity — Anika to own outreach + one-pager for pilot customers; 2) Latency targets — Mike/Cora to drive a 10% improvement in p50/p99 over next 2 sprints; 3) Compliance — Priya to finish DPA + KMS gating docs by Wednesday.

Sam: Risks — APAC dedicated pools could be capacity constrained the week of Apr 6 (queued requests spike). If we see >15% reject rate, fallback to hosted routing and notify sales. Also extend canary window by 48h for private GA to catch slow regressions. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-ga

Anika: Thanks Sam. I'll post the pilot customer list and outreach cadence in #sales today and share the one-pager in this channel by Monday.

Mike: Noted. SRE update: saw a KV cache hit-rate dip (~−3ppt) overnight that may explain some tail latency blips. Investigating kernel selection logs and will propose a rollback plan or kernel swap by EOD.

Cora: Oncall has pre-provisioned burst nodes for dedicated pools. I'll take the lead on updating the canary runbook and test checklist. @Sam — 48h extension sounds reasonable, would reduce noisy false positives. :thinking_face:

Priya: DPA review in final pass, two small redlines around subprocessor disclosure. Will send final signed DPA and KMS integration checklist by Tue EOD.

Sam: Appreciate it. Approving the 48h canary extension. Please ping me if the KV regression persists or customer pilots report quality drops. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary-extension request recorded (id: canary-1721) — approver: Sam — new cutover ETA +48h.

Mike: Will share the kernel-swap timeline and postmortem stub in #eng-sre once we confirm root cause.

Anika: One more ask — solutions team, prepare customer-facing notes for any GA delay windows. I'll coordinate messaging with marketing if needed.
